clauses.fragment: Represent intended source changes as explicit data against identified snapshots.
clauses.scenario: Submit an explicit change against one identified immutable snapshot; changing focus cannot retarget it.
clauses.residual: Concrete request and snapshot identity types; D33.
clauses.risk: Spoofed source identity must not acquire mutation authority.

clauses.fragment: Use one canonical source-change semantics for publication, selection/attachment mapping, conditional history inverses and derived invalidation.
clauses.scenario: Compare source, mapped target, inverse and invalidation for one admitted edit under the same starting context.
clauses.residual: The finite model has one representative edit/profile; full mappings, invalidation and implementation refinement remain; D04/D33/D45.
clauses.risk: Divergent transformations can tamper with companions while text appears correct.

clauses.fragment: Different typed representations may refine that contract;
clauses.scenario: Lower each supported representation to the same semantic change and compare its authoritative projection.
clauses.residual: Actual representation relations and lowering; D33/D45.
clauses.risk: A type or adapter boundary cannot silently change the admitted operation.

clauses.fragment: adapters must not implement competing mutation or coordinate rules.
clauses.scenario: Invoke identical explicit edits through each supported adapter and facade; compare semantic results, not pixels.
clauses.residual: Concrete adapter lowering and platform fixtures; D28/D33/D43/D45.
clauses.risk: Frontend selection or coordinates cannot bypass the common mutation gate.

clauses.fragment: Do not require total/invertible mappings where target deletion or context loss makes them undefined;
clauses.scenario: Delete a target interior or lose mapping context; require the declared detached/unavailable disposition rather than inventing a survivor.
clauses.residual: Representative point profile only; complete attachment/deletion/undo policies; D04/D19.
clauses.risk: Fabricated target identity can attach protected authored content to the wrong object.

clauses.fragment: return explicit disposition.
clauses.scenario: Observe an undefined mapping through every supported result surface without interpreting it as a valid position.
clauses.residual: Public disposition and recipient-safe field shapes; D04/D05/D19/D33.
clauses.risk: Disposition metadata itself requires current recipient-safe projection.

clauses.fragment: Stage all required authoritative participants, including annotation/view/history state as applicable, through the same publication boundary.
clauses.scenario: Fail the last required companion stage and verify no source, view, annotation or history publication; then publish the complete candidate coherently.
clauses.residual: Actual participant inventory, annotation/view profiles and staging failures; D04/D19/D33/D43.
clauses.risk: Partial publication is an integrity failure, not partial success.

clauses.fragment: Internal modules retain typed state/version/dependency contracts;
clauses.scenario: Attempt to omit or mistype a required version/dependency across a module interface; reject before publication.
clauses.residual: Concrete module/API contracts; D33/D34/D43.
clauses.risk: Untyped dependencies can hide authority or freshness changes.

clauses.fragment: arbitrary extension callbacks must not run inside publication.
clauses.scenario: Instrument the final critical section and inject formatter/subscriber/exporter reentry; no arbitrary callback executes there.
clauses.residual: Actual call graph, reentry and diagnostic callback conformance; D23/D33/D36/D43.
clauses.risk: Callback reentry, latency and privilege escalation at the serialized boundary.

clauses.fragment: This does not select a dynamic module runtime.
clauses.scenario: Build the supported headless path without a dynamic module runtime or loader.
clauses.residual: Package/feature matrix and implementation evidence; D43.
clauses.risk: Audit IDs and typed participant contracts are not a new execution capability.

clauses.fragment: Resolve each proposal into per-document change sets against identified revisions.
clauses.scenario: Change a participating source after preparation; a stale exact-revision proposal cannot publish.
clauses.residual: The model abstracts text values and captures revisions itself; real proposal lowering/identity validation remains; D02/D33.
clauses.risk: Revision substitution cannot turn a stale request into the same valid request.

clauses.fragment: Within each change set, edit ranges refer to the starting document and use half-open intervals.
clauses.scenario: Apply length-changing adjacent and separated replacements and compare original-snapshot byte results with the reference oracles.
clauses.residual: Finite strict-gap TLC support plus separate adjacency/oracle evidence; full canonicalizer/profile refinement remains; D02/D45.
clauses.risk: Sequential-coordinate confusion can overwrite unintended bytes.

clauses.fragment: Sequential edit algorithms must compose their results into this representation before commit.
clauses.scenario: Lower a sequential edit plan to original-snapshot replacements and compare forward result and reverse inverse recovery.
clauses.residual: Real lowering/normalization and insertion ties; D02/D33/D45.
clauses.risk: An execution algorithm cannot redefine public coordinate meaning.

clauses.fragment: Reject ambiguous overlaps and same-position ordering unless the caller has explicitly resolved them into an unambiguous change set.
clauses.scenario: Offer unresolved overlap and same-position ties; require unchanged refusal without incidental enumeration-order resolution.
clauses.residual: Concrete overlap/tie validation, ordering representation and safe outcomes; D02/D33.
clauses.risk: Attacker-controlled iteration order cannot decide conflicting edits.

clauses.fragment: Validate resulting selections and read-only restrictions along with text changes.
clauses.scenario: Combine a valid text edit with invalid selection mapping or a read-only/insertion-boundary violation; reject the whole proposal.
clauses.residual: ScopeSafe models a source write scope, not all selection/read-only profiles; D04/D33/D45.
clauses.risk: Companion updates and insertion boundaries cannot bypass read-only authority.

clauses.fragment: Stage candidate documents, selection mappings, and required history metadata before publication.
clauses.scenario: Pause after one participant is staged; observers still see a published root and no host effect consumes the private candidate.
clauses.residual: Concrete allocation/companion completeness; D04/D13/D33/D43.
clauses.risk: Private preparation is not recipient-visible commitment.

clauses.fragment: Validate final dependencies, current authority, resource limits, and capability requirements at the commit boundary.
clauses.scenario: Vary each dependency, grant, required capability and reservation immediately before final validation; no unchecked candidate publishes.
clauses.residual: Transactions checks abstract grant/context/revisions, not complete capability/resource contracts; D06/D33/D42.
clauses.risk: Spoofing, stale authority and resource exhaustion must fail at enforcement, not telemetry.

clauses.fragment: Stale candidates must be rebuilt or rejected;
clauses.scenario: Invalidate a prepared candidate; reject or rebuild under the unchanged request preconditions before a new final gate.
clauses.residual: Rebuild path, candidate equivalence and actual invalidation classifier; D33/D34.
clauses.risk: Rebuild cannot silently refresh the caller's expected source revisions.

clauses.fragment: validation alone must not authorize publishing a candidate based on a different document state.
clauses.scenario: Interleave a relevant commit after preliminary validation; the prior success does not authorize publication.
clauses.residual: Concrete serialized validation/publication implementation; D33/D43.
clauses.risk: Time-of-check/time-of-use tampering.

clauses.fragment: Validation must include non-text state used to prepare the operation, such as participating view/selection generations, read-only policy, resource binding and configuration.
clauses.scenario: Change each used non-text dependency while source revisions stay equal; revalidate or reject without restoring old companions.
clauses.residual: Abstract context counters do not prove complete dependency discovery; D04/D33/D34/D35.
clauses.risk: Hidden context changes can alter authority or operation meaning.

clauses.fragment: An unchanged text revision is insufficient when those dependencies changed.
clauses.scenario: Keep text fixed and change configuration, binding or selection context; stale preparation cannot pass solely on source revision.
clauses.residual: Actual compatibility/dependency validators; D33/D34/D35.
clauses.risk: Source freshness is not context or permission freshness.

clauses.fragment: Recompute mappings against current state or reject;
clauses.scenario: Move the selection during preparation; recompute using current validated state or reject the candidate.
clauses.residual: Concrete recomputation/current-state refinement and selection policy; D04/D33/D45.
clauses.risk: A recomputation must not acquire undeclared write scope.

clauses.fragment: publication must not restore an obsolete selection merely because text matched.
clauses.scenario: Prepare against selection A, publish unrelated selection B, then attempt the candidate; B is not overwritten through a stale whole-state copy.
clauses.residual: Actual view-state frame and participant refinement; D04/D33/D43.
clauses.risk: Lost updates to non-text authored state.

clauses.fragment: Publish a local logical change across managed documents and workspaces as one atomic coordinator state transition.
clauses.scenario: Observe a two-document, cross-workspace commit through pinned roots; no mixed before/after publication is available.
clauses.residual: Finite abstract documents, no actual workspace membership/concurrency implementation; D33/D43.
clauses.risk: Atomic local publication does not promise cross-authority isolation.

clauses.fragment: Failed validation or staging must leave authoritative text, selections, revisions, and history unchanged.
clauses.scenario: Fail preparation or final validation after an unrelated commit; compare with immediately preceding state, not the old preparation snapshot.
clauses.residual: Complete companion and allocator-failure conformance; D04/D33/D43.
clauses.risk: Rejecting this operation cannot roll back another operation.

clauses.fragment: Failure diagnostics may still be emitted.
clauses.scenario: Toggle capture off/full/fault during rejection; authoritative state/outcome is unchanged and released diagnostics remain recipient-safe.
clauses.residual: Actual sinks, reentry, minimized fields, overhead and release tests; D36/D37/D38/D39.
clauses.risk: Diagnostics cannot authorize publication, disclose protected content or erase authoritative status.

clauses.fragment: A commit must have one operation identity and one new coordinator generation.
clauses.scenario: Publish a multi-document request; one operation and fresh generation identify the whole commit.
clauses.residual: TypeOK relates generation to log length, not real operation-ID uniqueness/exhaustion; D03/D33.
clauses.risk: Confusable identifiers can misattribute outcomes or history.

clauses.fragment: Each text-changing document receives one new monotonic document revision;
clauses.scenario: Publish a multi-document edit and compare each changed document's previous and new revision; unchanged documents retain theirs.
clauses.residual: Actual finite counter/exhaustion and incarnation representation; D03/D33.
clauses.risk: Revision reuse must not admit stale work.

clauses.fragment: selection-only updates do not advance document revisions.
clauses.scenario: Change only selection and verify source revision is stable while the relevant view/publication context advances under its contract.
clauses.residual: Concrete selection command/context specification; D04/D33/D45.
clauses.risk: Separate freshness domains must not be collapsed.

clauses.fragment: Undo and redo that change text create new revisions rather than restoring old revision IDs.
clauses.scenario: Edit, undo and redo to equal bytes; each text change has a fresh revision and old requests stay stale.
clauses.residual: Actual history/refinement, finite IDs and linked group profiles; D03/D13/D14.
clauses.risk: Byte equality does not establish revision identity or renewed authority.

clauses.fragment: Cross-authority operations carry participant versions and local commit IDs;
clauses.scenario: Reject an unsupported cross-authority atomic request before local mutation; any supported host orchestration distinguishes local participant facts.
clauses.residual: Cross-authority atomic editing remains excluded from v1; no protocol or federation requirement is introduced.
clauses.risk: Do not infer global authority from local IDs.

clauses.fragment: no globally atomic snapshot or total revision order is implied.
clauses.scenario: Review discovery/outcome contracts for any claim that independent authorities share one atomic root or total revision order.
clauses.residual: V1 scope exclusion, not a federation proof or runtime implementation.
clauses.risk: Local evidence cannot advertise a stronger global consistency guarantee.

clauses.fragment: Commit metadata must identify the affected documents and their before/after revisions.
clauses.scenario: Inspect authoritative internal metadata for each participant; separately verify recipient projections do not leak hidden participants.
clauses.residual: Concrete internal/result schemas and recipient-safe projection; D05/D10/D33.
clauses.risk: Required internal attribution is not permission for public topology disclosure.

clauses.fragment: Observers and host effects may receive committed changes only after publication.
clauses.scenario: Pause staging and observe/effect capture; only published state can be attributed as committed.
clauses.residual: The save script checks selected capture ordering, not every subscriber/effect surface; D23/D33/D36.
clauses.risk: Private candidate bytes cannot be released under a fabricated commit receipt.

clauses.fragment: Callback or later effect failure must not turn a committed change into a reported validation rejection.
clauses.scenario: Publish, then fail notification/export/diagnostics; preserve Applied while separately reporting the later delivery/effect limit.
clauses.residual: Bounded diagnostic reference case only; real callbacks/effects/public status profiles; D05/D23/D33/D36.
clauses.risk: Observation failure cannot falsify authoritative publication history.

clauses.fragment: External dependency tokens must have explicit freshness and validation contracts.
clauses.scenario: Offer an external token without an accepted freshness/validation meaning; do not infer it satisfies a stronger dependency contract.
clauses.residual: Concrete host token/provenance/provider contracts; D07/D15/D16/D46.
clauses.risk: Opaque token equality is not proof of external currentness or causality.

clauses.fragment: A locally serialized commit must not claim isolation from uncoordinated disk writers or external index changes;
clauses.scenario: Inject an external write/index change outside local serialization; report only guarantees actually supplied by the host contract.
clauses.residual: Actual external writer/provider evidence and scope; D07/D15/D16/D46.
clauses.risk: A local mutex cannot enforce an external writer's behavior.

clauses.fragment: where needed, the host must provide a reservation or equivalent guarantee, or application must fail.
clauses.scenario: Require a guarantee the provider cannot supply; refuse before applying rather than silently reducing isolation.
clauses.residual: Concrete required-guarantee admission and provider evidence; D15/D16/D33/D46.
clauses.risk: Unsupported capability cannot be upgraded by a diagnostic or token claim.

clauses.fragment: Transaction boundaries and undo grouping are distinct.
clauses.scenario: Perform two independent publications in one permitted history group; neither is retroactively the other's publication boundary.
clauses.residual: Concrete group lifecycle/lowering; D13/D14/D33.
clauses.risk: History grouping is not permission for partial publication or rollback.

clauses.fragment: Related typing transactions may form an undo group;
clauses.scenario: Under a selected explicit grouping profile, append compatible transactions and verify incompatible plans stay separate.
clauses.residual: Typing/join/close profile remains open; D13/D45. This clause does not select a timeout or compatibility schema.
clauses.risk: User/plan attribution must not merge unrelated agent work.

clauses.fragment: indivisible cross-document changes must retain their shared operation identity for linked history handling.
clauses.scenario: Attempt reversal with one linked participant unavailable or blocked; preserve the whole indivisible change and shared identity.
clauses.residual: Real operation IDs, linked-group storage/frontier/retention refinement; D03/D13/D14.
clauses.risk: Partial reversal cannot masquerade as complete shared history.
